quests.title: The Illumiscreen: III

dialogue.t: If you'd like to have a try, please come back at nighttime.

dialogue.sit: Do you have another image for me?

dialogue.t: You bet! And since you solved both the previous ones so easily, I've swapped the lanterns for the most difficult ones available.
The same principle applies — you combine three images to make one whole. The difficulty is in the fact that they're <color=#00E1FFFF>linked together</color> this time.
Hehe, you'll see what I mean when you give it a try. This time, you're looking for a <color=#00E1FFFF>divine crane</color>.
Once you've got the images to align, you can go find the treasure.
This time, try and make a <color=#00E1FFFF>crane</color>.
All in a day's work for you, huh? I gotta say, you're one heck of an adventurer.
Go take a look at the screens. You'll find all the treasure clues in there.
The treasure has all been prepared specially by the Guild. Happy hunting.
How is the treasure hunt going?
Wow, you managed to decipher all three images... That's impressive...
Ahem. The Guild has prepared an extra-special gift for you on account of you being such an accomplished adventurer.
See those chests? Go ahead and open them. The contents are all for you.

dialogue.sit: But if I take all the prizes...

dialogue.t: Yep, there'll be squat left for anyone else. That's adventuring for you! Finders keepers.
Alright then, happy Lantern Rite. Have a good one.

quests.description: Brother Qian from the Liyue Adventurers’ Guild is still inviting people to try playing with the Illumiscreen…
